topic: What if you got the GTA6 hospital bill in real life?
title: WHAT IF YOU GOT THE HOSPITAL BILL
IN REAL LIFE?

youtube.title: What If You Got the GTA6 Hospital Bill in Real Life?
youtube.intro:
Every time you get hurt, you blink back to the hospital doors, completely healed. Like a game. There's just one difference: the hospital sends you the bill, and every line on it is a real American price. By Tuesday you owe two million dollars. Then a man in a grey suit offers to pay it all.

This episode is part of our In Real Life series: what happens when game rules meet the real world. Watch the whole series in the playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLKLZI7vWFMpg

A fan-made, original story. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. No game footage, characters or music are used.
youtube.pinned_comment:
Would you have signed the contract? 👇

And what does the company really want with someone who can't die? Best theory gets pinned before Part 2.

The prices are real: a helicopter ambulance has a median price of $36,400 (GAO), a trauma team activation can cost over $50,000 (KFF Health News), and a high spinal cord injury costs about $1.37 million in its first year (NSCISC). About 20 million US adults owe medical debt. Sources are in the description.

This is one episode of our In Real Life series: the whole playlist is linked in the description.
